description: PUTS THE SERIES CATALOGUE ON SCREEN as a grid of previews the user can look at and pick from, right in this conversation: each tile shows that series' 9:16 still, plays its demo clip in place, and choosing one (select a tile, then confirm) posts the choice into the chat as a message from the user. Free, instant, spends nothing. It is the answer to 'what series are there' on a client that renders cards: call it the moment the user wants to make a story episode or asks what story formats exist and has not named one, because a series is chosen BY EYE. WHEN NOT: the user already named a series, or asked about ONE series' prices, lengths or defaults (go straight to `list_series` with `series_id`), or the client renders no cards (a terminal, a script): use `list_series` there and present a shortlist in text. If the user says they cannot see a picker, fall back to `list_series` and do not call this again. AFTER: say ONE short line (the series are on screen, pick one) and STOP. Do not list or describe the series, call `list_series` to see what is in the grid, or ask in text as well. The card loads its own catalogue and posts the user's pick into this conversation: that message is your signal. The card stays live, so if a later message says to ignore the series they picked and names another, THE LATER MESSAGE WINS COMPLETELY: drop everything for the old series and start again from the new one; never merge the two or ask which they meant. OUTPUT: one short object naming the catalogue, for the card. Do not paste or summarise it.
name: browse_series
title: Show the AI Video Story series as a picker
